name: What are the key features of an accessible shower?

mainEntity.name: What are the key features of an accessible shower?

acceptedAnswer.text: Key features of an accessible shower often include a zero-threshold or roll-in entry to eliminate steps, a spacious layout for maneuverability, and secure grab bars strategically placed. Other enhancements can include a built-in or fold-down bench, handheld showerheads, and easy-to-operate controls. AKN Design Group specializes in designing spa-inspired bathrooms that incorporate these elements without compromising on luxury or style. Our integrated design-build process ensures these customized solutions are functional, beautiful, and seamlessly integrated into your home.
acceptedAnswer.description: An accessible shower typically features zero-threshold entry, ample space, and grab bars. AKN Design Group integrates these elements into luxurious, functional designs.
